name: bathhouse-services
reviewNotes: All twelve original glyph records reviewed. Preserve the ten-ryo-per-person fee, both dynamic number fields, full HP/MP recovery notice and A-button exit instruction.
Use existing 露肚怪; retain the joke contrasting heavenly bathing comfort with a creature from hell. No bathing, payment or recovery behavior is changed.
